focus: Build an evidence-ranked inventory of all meaningful architecture families and training runs, including recurrent partial-untied, Nanochat/transformer baselines, long-sequence anchors, Wave variants, neuron variants, and token-recall candidates. Identify apples-to-apples comparisons and comparability flaws.

Audit exact-function performance optimizations for RTX 3080 10GB and eventual H100: kernels, tensor layouts, conv/state operations, sampled softmax, precision, optimizer state, compilation, checkpointing, and data pipeline.

Analyze the missing token-addressable recall path and current factor_recall_gated_multiscale implementation. Propose subquadratic mechanisms that can copy exact identities and support induction/binding, with equations, complexity, insertion points, and probes.

Explore architecture directions adjacent to causal multi-scale low-rank conv-memory: selective state space, gated recurrence, associative memory, low-rank routing, and hybrid sparse/local attention. Reject cosmetic activation swaps.

Diagnose scaling and optimization from 80M, 160M, 2B/5B, continuation, and LR schedule runs. Reconstruct loss behavior and distinguish learning-rate, data reuse, objective, capacity, context mixing, instability, and noise.

Audit sampled-vocabulary and full-vocabulary evaluation. State what current losses prove, what is incomparable, and design the minimum copy/induction/long-context/full-vocab suite needed before scale-up.
Audit parameter/FLOP allocation from 10M through 350M. Identify dominant matrices and bandwidth limits, then propose concrete parameter-matched shapes for next screens.

Review recent primary-source work on linear/subquadratic attention, state-space language models, gated convolutions, and associative retrieval. Map only implementable mechanisms to this repo with exact prototypes and falsification tests.
